page_title: MON 4-1 HOL | B. Monchengladbach v Holstein Kiel 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The goal by B. Monchengladbach won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
89' Wait! Referee Daniel Schlager has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
88' Goal! 5:1. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
88' A great pass puts Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.

87' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Schlager with no other option than to blow for a foul.
86' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Joe Scally.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Rocco Reitz.
86' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Franck Honorat will be replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
83' A substitution has been made. Armin Gigovic goes off and Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Robin Hack is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
80' Substitution. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Lukas Ullrich.

79' 4 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
77' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
76' The attendance for today's match is 52210.
75' Holstein Kiel take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Steven Skrzybski departs the field of play to be replaced by Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel).
72' Holstein Kiel keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
69' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
68' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

65' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Moritz Nicolas. This effort really didn't trouble him.
64' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) sends a wild header high over the bar.
64' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
64' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lewis Holtby leaves the pitch and Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) comes on.
61' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
60' Holstein Kiel can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Flag up against Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
56' What a big chance! Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
54' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
53' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
52' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
52' The ball is cleared after Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.
50' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) is flagged for offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) is replaced by Benedikt Pichler.
46' Half-time substitution. Marvin Schulz will not participate anymore and Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) is coming on.
46' Referee Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

45+1' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' 3 - 1 The resulting corner is whipped in by Franck Honorat and Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top left corner. The score is 3:1.
43' There's an opportunity for Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

43' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.

41' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Timon Weiner makes a comfortable save.
40' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul after dangerous play.
37' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Daniel Schlager couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) and blew his whistle.
36' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle.
32' An accurate cross picks out Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.

30' 2 - 1 Finn Porath passes to Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the top right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:1.
26' 2 - 0 Goal! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 2:0.
24' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
21' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
19' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach), whose header floated just over the bar.
17' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle as Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
14' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
12' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is adjudged offside.
6' It looks like Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
3' Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

1' 1 - 0 Franck Honorat sends a superb cross into the box. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the roof of the net, leaving Timon Weiner beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Holstein Kiel will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniel Schlager.
